title: Formal Turkish
summary: Read and write the Turkish of news, notices and offices: the formal progressive `-mAktA(dIr)`, `-DIr` in definitions and rules (*Giriş ücretsizdir*), formal link words such as *ayrıca*, *ancak* and *-mAsI nedeniyle*, the formulas of a formal email, and fractions and percentages read aloud (*üçte bir*, *yüzde elli*).
canDo: Understand news reports, announcements and official notices
Write a notice with opening times, prices and rules
Write a short formal email that makes a polite request
Read figures, fractions and percentages aloud, and follow a report full of numbers
